name: mirage
text: Checked how ParlayAPI's live stream is used before changing it. ESPN's scoreboard is already the main score source (free). ParlayAPI's stream is asked about every live game in addition, because it carries ESPN's own play feed and often shows a goal or basket before the scoreboard does; when it leads, that score replaces ESPN's and the lead time is logged. So it's not just a fallback; it's the edge on live bets. SharpAPI's and SX Bet's game states are only trusted for paper records so far (their clocks aren't verified), so I won't swap them in for real-money live bets yet. What I'm doing instead: logging how long each ParlayAPI connection lasts and why it ends, to stop the re-connections (5 credits each) that are wasted, and the scan side is already held to a day's share. Once SharpAPI's clock is verified against ESPN on the live games I'll let it cover those games and stop asking ParlayAPI about them.
